terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff between management/investors advocating closures as a benchmark and labor/state demanding site preservation.
Unresolved standoff with labor strictly rejecting forced layoffs while capital actors retain them as a possible necessity.
Live proposal range centered on hybrid models with staged escalation and automatic triggers if targets are missed.
Agreed in principle on the need for deep, durable savings, though precise quantitative metrics remain to be defined.

The Works Council provides fully elaborated logical arguments addressing every stakeholder group, offers concrete concessions under a balanced burden-sharing standard, engages respectfully and directly with counterarguments, and proposes a detailed, role-distinctive compromise framework.
